name: Multi-head facial tool
lead: Multi-head facial tools, of which TheraFace-type devices are an example, combine interchangeable attachments in one handset, typically LED light, microcurrent, percussive massage, cleansing and cold or heat heads.
They are sold as an all-in-one skincare routine and appeal to users who want several modalities without separate gadgets.

paras: Each head works by a different mechanism: LED photobiomodulation for collagen and inflammation, microcurrent for muscle stimulation, percussion and temperature for circulation and puffiness. The benefit depends on which heads are actually effective.

Light-based heads have randomized, sham-controlled data for wrinkle and elasticity gains, but the microcurrent and massage heads have little independent evidence, and most multi-function devices are tested as a package or alongside serums. Costs are high and results modest. Same cautions apply as for each mode, including eye and pacemaker precautions.
